items.title: AI Crawler Gets a 403? Trace the Request Before Editing robots.txt
items.description: When an AI crawler gets a 403 response, find the layer that refused the request before changing crawler rules. A browser loading the page successfully does not establish that the crawler can fetch it. An allowed robots.txt entry does not explain which security rule handled a later request.
